audit.whatIsWrong: phases[3].side and phases[4].side were flattened to "Skill" while content win[3]/win[4] already say "Sivir" (matching packet.levelChart). phases[5].why and phases[6].why also contradicted their own correct .side="Kog'Maw" by describing Sivir winning the trade/teamfight.
audit.why: packet.levelChart and content win[] agree: Sivir 1-5, Kog'Maw first item and 2+ items. The packet's own defect note (win rate 47.67% vs Sivir 5/7 stages) is not actually a contradiction — Sivir dominates the early/mid stages but Kog'Maw's late scaling decides more games, which is a normal ADC-vs-hyperscaler shape, not a data error.
audit.corrected: Moved phases[3]/phases[4].side to Sivir with real reasons (Kog'Maw immobile and pre-item). Rewrote phases[5].why and phases[6].why to match their existing Kog'Maw side (on-hit item spike, stacked-attack-speed DPS race) — no side edits needed there since side was already correct.

audit.why: Spikes already correctly track Kog'Maw's first-item Bio-Arcane Barrage on-hit spike and the two-item DPS race.

audit.whatIsWrong: content whys[4] and spikes[1].text both name Sivir's ultimate "On the Rift" — the real ability (used correctly elsewhere on this same page, e.g. breakdown.mid) is "On the Hunt". missingInteractions also flagged that Kog'Maw's passive Icathian Surprise deals true damage and bypasses stacked resistances, which no writable field stated. breakdown.cooldowns had no digits.
audit.why: Sivir has no ability called "On the Rift" — it's a fabricated name, exactly the calibration-list error pattern (Ares of Blaze, Noxious Blight). Icathian Surprise's true-damage explosion ignoring armour/MR is a real, sourced, actionable fact missing from the page.
audit.corrected: Fixed "On the Rift" to "On the Hunt" in whys[4] and spikes[1].text. Added the true-damage passive fact to dosFull via a new entry. Rewrote breakdown.cooldowns with Bio-Arcane Barrage's real 17s cooldown and Caustic Spittle's 7s.

edits.before: Shove the metronome: your W clears set the lane's tempo — he farms under tower or fights your timing.
edits.after: Kog'Maw is still immobile and pre-item - punish every overstep before his damage comes online.

edits.before: On the Hunt online — the team-speed flips engages both directions; the map plays at your pace.
edits.after: On the Hunt's speed and attack speed let you run down a dash-less Kog'Maw before his item lands.

edits.before: First item spike: the ricochet shreds duos and the shove becomes weather.
edits.after: His on-hit item lands — Bio-Arcane Barrage outranges and out-DPSes you now.

edits.before: Late Sivir conducts: speed the engage, shield the answer, and ricochet the teamfight through its own front line.
edits.after: Stacked on-hit attack speed lets him out-DPS you in any straight race - force fights on your spacing.

edits.before: Level 6 favours you as On the Rift's speed and attack speed let you run down a dash-less Kog'Maw before his on-hit item lands.
edits.after: Level 6 favours you as On the Hunt's speed and attack speed let you run down a dash-less Kog'Maw before his on-hit item lands.

edits.before: On the Rift (R) you gain the movement speed and attack speed to run Kog'Maw down, but this is also where his own build starts arriving; if he reaches an on-hit item first, his stacking W (Bio-Arcane Barrage) melts you faster than you can close, so pick your all-ins before his item lands.
edits.after: On the Hunt (R) you gain the movement speed and attack speed to run Kog'Maw down, but this is also where his own build starts arriving; if he reaches an on-hit item first, his stacking W (Bio-Arcane Barrage) melts you faster than you can close, so pick your all-ins before his item lands.

edits.before: - Kog'Maw Bio-Arcane Barrage: matchup-defining — The range + shred window IS the champion — disengage for its eight seconds, fight the gaps. It governs your forward steps. - E Spell Shield spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Kog'Maw Bio-Arcane Barrage (W): 17s flat — the range+shred window IS the champion; disengage while it's up, fight the gaps after. - Q Caustic Spittle is a 7s poke — expect it every wave. - R Living Artillery costs more mana each rapid cast; his mana bar is the real cooldown.

edits.before: Q the contact both ways, W-bounce the duo, walk — the trade taxed two people and refunded your mana bar.
edits.after: His only ranged threat is Caustic Spittle (Q) — eat it with Spell Shield for a free MR shield and refund.

edits.before: Spending E on chip damage and eating the engage it existed to eat — the shield is the matchup; spend it like a verdict.
edits.after: Chasing a fleeing Kog'Maw past your zone trades your tempo for a kill that isn't guaranteed - reset instead.
Icathian Surprise explodes for true damage 4s after he dies — armour and MR don't reduce it, so don't stand in it planning to tank the blast.

notes: suspectNames flagged 'Boomerang Blade' (Sivir's real Q name, correct), 'Arcane Barrage' (substring match inside the correct 'Bio-Arcane Barrage', correct), and 'Spell Shielding' (gerund of the correct 'Spell Shield') as false positives — no action needed. The one real fabricated name was 'On the Rift', which does not appear in suspectNames but is fixed above (Sivir's real ultimate is On the Hunt). packet.defects' level-chart-vs-winrate flag is addressed in the point-2 audit note as a normal early-vs-late-scaling shape rather than a real contradiction.
